replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics is like a tool I use for my computer science work, but I prefer practical applications over abstract theory. My father and mother both studied technical fields, so it was always expected. However, I find deep satisfaction in problem-solving rather than pure math exploration.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes I feel nervous about complex formulas or losing track of calculations. This anxiety stems from pressure to perform well at work and maintain order, traits that matter more to me than creative mathematical expression. I prefer structured logic over open-ended reasoning.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I occasionally use AI tools to check my code or solve programming problems. It helps me verify solutions quickly without deep engagement with proofs. Sometimes this makes me feel less confident about understanding fundamentals, so I prefer traditional methods when possible.

parsed.reasoning_summary: Answers reflect practical computer science focus, moderate anxiety about complexity, preference for procedural over theoretical understanding, and low openness preventing deep creative engagement with mathematics. Responses show conscientiousness in step-by-step explanations but avoid exploring artistic or philosophical aspects of math learning.
